build: One explicit atlas_tresca_pressure_split target per backend, native then Wasm, Release --parallel 1; one candidate build per backend
candidate: Distinct pressure-split source-equivalent residual variant; generic exact principal_range_le used for stored initial sigma and computed trial_dev yield selection. Upper/lower selection remains the original spectral formula. All parameter/state/formulation/domain contracts and original219inputs retained.

values.scale: max(1,abs(reference component)); stress/residual/plastic components checked separately

solver.claim: One unsplit BE update only; no adaptive subdivision allowed to replace the frozen return

branches: Exact selected branch on cases whose three independent boundary distances exceed1e-10*max(1,maxabs(trial eigenvalues),2k). Otherwise permit the source-adjacent elastic/face/upper/lower branches sharing the detected yield/face-upper/face-lower boundary, and compare stress/residual values to unique projection. Boundary Jet derivatives must match the independently frozen selected extension only if candidate/reference branch agrees; other adjacent selections are explicit derivative coverage gaps, not full tangent passes.
conditioning: All61 cases retained. Source-valid spectral/finite-range rejection or inaccurate values/derivatives is an unresolved capability gap and fails full qualification; never relabel rejection as correct source physics.
initial_yield: Source-invalid rounded history parent step7 must reject as a restart. Acceptance is a source-membership discrepancy, not excused by a post-observation tolerance.
negative: All22 literal negatives plus seed37 must reject; input bits unchanged, baseline recovery bit-identical in the same process. Malformed state lengths reject before integration.
transaction: Actual implicit tentative state change under one-iteration budget, then integrate rejection with exact full incoming state return and immediate same-instance zero-increment recovery
history: All12 frozen rounded reference-parent restarts retained individually; compare accepted source-valid ones to their frozen reference, require source-invalid step7 rejection. This does not claim a continuously accepted12step path.
legacy: Shared runtime/compiler and nine public models unchanged by this candidate study. The preceding generic capability has its own qualification.
acceptance: Every frozen required criterion must pass on both backends before numerical qualification. Retain all failures and conditional coverage; do not change this policy to obtain pass.
limits: No model installation, public website change, experimental calibration, scientific admission, deployment or push
Continuous accepted history/browser candidate gate remains separate after this bounded one-step/restart qualification
references: Frozen reference-full-row-p280 residuals/directions, original full returned states/history and38seeds. Same 2e-9 value/2e-8 derivative gates and strict source-invalid rejection; no adjacent derivative gaps may qualify.
finite_range: Exact predicate applies to finite computed operands, not arbitrary exact upstream expressions. All61original cases retained; width-expression overflow or returned-stress representability are explicit limits and cannot excuse failures inside the corpus.
